name: BOOLEAN_TOGGLE_ISOMORPHISM
description: Transforms a vector span / graph connectivity problem into a boolean state reachability problem. Edges become operations that toggle two boolean variables simultaneously. Reaching a state where exactly two variables are TRUE is mathematically identical to finding a path between them in a graph (due to transitivity in GF(2)), but this framing completely removes all graph and vector space terminology, forcing the model to independently discover the shortest-path/Steiner-tree isomorphism.
